testcase.name: Given a blank token when launch reconcile runs then reconcileToken is never called()
Given no active accounts when launch reconcile runs then reconcileToken short-circuits and does not throw()
Given a failed token fetch when launch reconcile runs then reconcileToken is never called and no exception propagates()
Given a reconcile that returns failure when launch reconcile runs then no exception propagates()
Given a null token when launch reconcile runs then reconcileToken is never called and no crash()
Given an injected IO dispatcher when launch reconcile runs then the register work runs on that dispatcher not Main()
Given a fetched token and the launch reconcile runs then reconcileToken is called with that token()
Given the same token when launch reconcile runs twice then reconcileToken is invoked each time without side effects()
